text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, the long-awaited results, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What else could it be? Increasing my
fandom, of
course.
choice_data_list_en: What's this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A lack of notoriety would diminish the

significance of racing in the Classic
Triple Crown,
after all.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Isn't that correct, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh, yes... Not that I could ever race
in the
Classic Triple Crown myself...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But fans are really important. I know that
for
sure...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I have instructed my fans to
gather at the
gymnasium.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If my efforts have succeeded, a standing
ovation
from a full house of my adoring
fans awaits!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If I've failed, the crickets will chirp! It
won't be
much different from the party
at the end of last
year, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, who will show their face? A
benevolent
angel or a cackling demon?
Will the gymnasium
be full of adoring
fans or completely empty?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The moment of truth has come. Open!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle, rattle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: That's Opera O! Hey, Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The number of fans are... decent. Same
goes for
the applause.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O-oh my! The venue is alive with the
sound of
applause!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It would not be an exaggeration to say I
have
charmed the people of the world,
would it,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her exaggerations, it isn't a
stretch to say
she'll be gaining even
more fans in the first race
of the the
Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that the Satsuki Sho is firmly
in my
sights...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Welcome my fans, one and all! Lend me
your ears!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O begins to give a speech.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The curtain to glory has been raised! My
mission
is simple, to defeat the older
generation and pass
the torch to mine!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, to do so, I must make my
presence felt
in the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It will be a long and arduous journey. A
great and
powerful foe will likely
attempt to bar my path.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But I shall not lose! The Overlord will
boldly fight
this adversary and claim
victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: But... who's the adversary?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Who? Who is it, Opera O?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My foe is no other than...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, Trainer? Go ahead, tell them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has the crowd in the palm of her
hand, but
with full confidence passes
their attention to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's too early to know who'll be favored
in the
Classics. The first name that comes
to mind is...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: M-me?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The Classics? On, no, no... I'd never
qualify. At
least... I don't think so!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto, now is not the time to dawdle.
Visualize the
future—ignore the reality!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Step forward and see how gloriously
your
unexpected presence resounds
throughout this
venue.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My worthy adversary is you, Doto, the
surprise
villain! Take my hand and rise
onto the stage!
Come, come!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto starts vigorously pacing,
eyes
darting every which way.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-what to do? She's inviting me... The Opera O is asking me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: She's my idol... But I'm... weak. Unghhh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want to try, b-but... I just know... I'll
never...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Sorry! I-I just... can't!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto runs away at full speed. I
guess that
push from Opera O is too
much pressure for her.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What?! Is this a rejection?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
By the heavens... I must have made her
nervous
with this excessive appeal of
mine.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But I will not stop now. Yes, what has
just
transpired simply makes this a
cliffhanger.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ladies and gentlemen! Who is this great

adversary I speak of? They will be
revealed...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
At the Satsuki Sho! So, come, and we
shall meet
again in the lush greens of
Nakayama, where I will
cross my blade
with theirs!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's managed to spin a convincing tale.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you have to find me a rival
before the
Satsuki Sho. They must be
exceptional, mind you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And, of course, I bear the full brunt of it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Opera O... Her hand was right there, and I...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I'm sorry I'm... so weak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Things get pretty out of hand with
today's event,
but T.M. Opera O
manages to gain more fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her path stretches forward now to the
Satsuki
Sho.
